about.title: About Low Income Seattle
about.intro: Low Income Seattle is a community-built directory of essential services for low-income and homeless residents of Seattle, WA.
about.whatBody: Up-to-date listings for food banks, free meal programs, and public shower facilities. Each entry includes the address, phone number, opening hours, and eligibility requirements.
about.dataBody: Food bank and shower data is community-maintained. Free meal data is pulled live from the City of Seattle's open data portal.
about.contributeBody: Found an error or know of a resource we're missing? Open an issue or pull request on GitHub.
